purpose: Single canonical cross-registry snapshot of RMD scientific maturity. Values in this manifest must agree with the authoritative accounting, dynamics, reference-mode, empirical-mechanism and validation registries; the manifest is not an independent source of scientific truth.
hard_invariants: Accounting Spine remains a hard constraint.
Partial/component/aggregate-only artifacts do not count as complete canonical instruments.
Behavioural closure remains inactive unless all declared activation gates pass.
No stale ACTIVATED label survives a CANDIDATE/DEFERRED validation disposition.
Reference-mode readiness is derived from the canonical registry rather than manually promoted.
A live provider refresh may create evidence for a new vintage but may not rewrite a retained historical result.
Prospective monetary response values remain inaccessible until the frozen event and release gates authorize inspection.
Every non-rejected behavioural mechanism has exactly one readiness entry and no duplicate readiness ownership.
A closed calibration cycle with zero activated mechanisms may not contain any mechanism authorized for estimation or refit.
After exhaustive source screening, a new empirical cycle requires a declared evidence/reopen trigger; queue exhaustion is not permission to respecify a failed form.

The exhausted sectoral-financial-position external counterpart path may reopen only on a declared new-source or changed-dataset trigger; repeating the same Eurostat/OECD source boundary is not scientific progress.
Every non-rejected behavioural mechanism has exactly one canonical reopen-condition entry with governing evidence and explicit non-reopen conditions.

Reopening a behavioural mechanism authorizes only its declared next evidence/identification gate and never automatically authorizes estimation/refit, holdout inspection, causal claims, System Dynamics activation or behavioural closure.

Reference-mode recovery may complete at a documented public-evidence boundary below 10/10 only when every missing mode has an explicit blocker, exhausted admissible current-public-source paths and declared reopen triggers.

The annual BNR counterpart stock matrix may be used as semantic evidence only; it may not be interpolated to quarters or used to substitute for the required quarterly stock-and-financial-transaction history.
